M.Awaiting proof

Prototype scope: titles, authors, abstracts, sections, paragraphs, lists, and references. TeX compilation is simulated; the PDF proof is real and downloadable. Non-Latin text needs a Unicode font backend. Figures, tables, equations, citations, journal rules, and PDF/A checks need a production backend.
